title: Courier Move — Rooftop Vault to Archive Loft
motionDescription: Kuro Signal coils low on the rooftop parapet, launches along a 35-degree diagonal stretch, vaults over the moonlit gap in a parkour tuck, flashes across the cable span in a cyan-magenta smear dash, brakes with a heel-plant skid, absorbs impact in a wide squash landing, and rebounds upright in front of the archive hatch thrusting the receiver forward.

reducedMotionAlternative.description: Kuro Signal standing upright in front of the archive loft hatch, thrusting the glowing portable receiver forward with an impatient grin.

frames.actingNote: Low crouched runner coil on rooftop ledge, heels lifted, receiver tucked tight against chest, hood compressed forward.
Diagonal upward launch off rooftop parapet along a 35-degree line of action, yellow boot sole kicking off ledge, magenta hip strap trailing.
Mid-air parkour tuck over moonlit gap between buildings, hood and hair trailing back, one hand bracing air, receiver clutched secure.
Dynamic comic smear streaks with cyan and magenta speed arcs and a stretched motion-blur silhouette across the rooftop cable span.
Forward leg drives down onto the archive loft roof, body leaned hard back to brake, yellow boot sole sparking small ink-dust marks.
Low squash impact absorb at archive doorway, knees bent wide, hoodie billowing down over shoulders, hair bouncing up.
Rebounds upright right in front of the archive hatch, receiver thrust eagerly forward with impatient grin and foot-tap energy.
